# Balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA with partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Testing main effect of 2-level factor (1 numerator df)
# Target: 80% power at alpha 0.05

# Design parameters
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
eta_p_sq <- 0.06  # partial eta-squared
num_cells <- 6    # 3 × 2 design
df_num <- 1       # numerator degrees of freedom for 2-level factor

# Convert partial eta-squared to Cohen's f
# For ANOVA: η_p² = f² / (1 + f²)
# Solving for f²: f² = η_p² / (1 - η_p²)
f_sq <- eta_p_sq / (1 - eta_p_sq)
f <- sqrt(f_sq)

cat("Effect size conversion:\n")
cat("Partial eta-squared (η_p²):", eta_p_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f²:", f_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f:", f, "\n\n")

# For balanced design with n participants per cell:
# Total N = 6n
# Denominator df = 6n - 6 (residual df from 6 cells)

# Non-centrality parameter: λ = f² × df_denominator
# For F-test: λ = (f² × df_denominator)

# We need to find minimum n such that power ≥ 0.80
# Power is computed from non-central F distribution:
# P(F > F_crit | H1) where F ~ F(df_num, df_denom, λ)

# Critical value at alpha = 0.05
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = Inf)  # approximate critical value
F_crit_exact <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = 100)  # more realistic

cat("Critical F value (α = 0.05, df1 = 1):\n")
cat("Using df2 = ∞:", F_crit, "\n")
cat("Using df2 = 100:", F_crit_exact, "\n\n")

# Function to calculate power given n (participants per cell)
calc_power <- function(n) {
  df_denom <- 6 * n - 6
  lambda <- f_sq * df_denom
  F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
  power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  return(power)
}

# Search for minimum n
cat("Power as a function of n (participants per cell):\n")
power_values <- data.frame()

for (n in 1:100) {
  pwr <- calc_power(n)
  power_values <- rbind(power_values, data.frame(n = n, power = pwr))
  
  if (n <= 15 || n %% 10 == 0) {
    cat("n =", sprintf("%3d", n), ": power =", sprintf("%.6f", pwr), "\n")
  }
}

# Find minimum n that achieves target power
min_n <- min(power_values$n[power_values$power >= target_power])
achieved_power <- power_values$power[power_values$n == min_n]
power_at_prev <- power_values$power[power_values$n == min_n - 1]

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per cell (n):", min_n, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", min_n, ":", sprintf("%.6f", achieved_power), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", min_n - 1, ":", sprintf("%.6f", power_at_prev), "\n")
cat("\nTotal N (across all 6 cells):", 6 * min_n, "\n")
cat("Denominator df at n =", min_n, ":", 6 * min_n - 6, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter λ at n =", min_n, ":", f_sq * (6 * min_n - 6), "\n")

# Testing main effect of 2-level factor (1 numerator df)
# Target: 80% power at alpha 0.05

alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
eta_p_sq <- 0.06  # partial eta-squared
num_cells <- 6    # 3 × 2 design
df_num <- 1       # numerator degrees of freedom for 2-level factor

# Convert partial eta-squared to Cohen's f
# For ANOVA: η_p² = f² / (1 + f²)
# Solving for f²: f² = η_p² / (1 - η_p²)
f_sq <- eta_p_sq / (1 - eta_p_sq)
f <- sqrt(f_sq)

cat("Effect size conversion:\n")
cat("Partial eta-squared (η_p²):", eta_p_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f²:", f_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f:", f, "\n\n")

# For balanced design with n participants per cell:
# Total N = 6n
# Denominator df = 6n - 6 (residual df from 6 cells)

# Non-centrality parameter: λ = f² × df_denominator
# For F-test: λ = (f² × df_denominator)

# We need to find minimum n such that power ≥ 0.80
# Power is computed from non-central F distribution:
# P(F > F_crit | H1) where F ~ F(df_num, df_denom, λ)

# Critical value at alpha = 0.05
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = Inf)  # approximate critical value
F_crit_exact <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = 100)  # more realistic

cat("Critical F value (α = 0.05, df1 = 1):\n")
cat("Using df2 = ∞:", F_crit, "\n")
cat("Using df2 = 100:", F_crit_exact, "\n\n")

  df_denom <- 6 * n - 6
  lambda <- f_sq * df_denom
  F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
  power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  return(power)
}

# Balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA with partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Testing main effect of 2-level factor (1 numerator df)
# Target: 80% power at alpha 0.05

# Design parameters
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
eta_p_sq <- 0.06  # partial eta-squared
num_cells <- 6    # 3 × 2 design
df_num <- 1       # numerator degrees of freedom for 2-level factor

# Convert partial eta-squared to Cohen's f
# For ANOVA: η_p² = f² / (1 + f²)
# Solving for f²: f² = η_p² / (1 - η_p²)
f_sq <- eta_p_sq / (1 - eta_p_sq)
f <- sqrt(f_sq)

cat("Effect size conversion:\n")
cat("Partial eta-squared (η_p²):", eta_p_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f²:", f_sq, "\n")
cat("Cohen's f:", f, "\n\n")

# For balanced design with n participants per cell:
# Total N = 6n
# Denominator df = 6n - 6 (residual df from 6 cells)

# Non-centrality parameter: λ = f² × df_denominator
# For F-test: λ = (f² × df_denominator)

# We need to find minimum n such that power ≥ 0.80
# Power is computed from non-central F distribution:
# P(F > F_crit | H1) where F ~ F(df_num, df_denom, λ)

# Critical value at alpha = 0.05
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = Inf)  # approximate critical value
F_crit_exact <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = 100)  # more realistic

cat("Critical F value (α = 0.05, df1 = 1):\n")
cat("Using df2 = ∞:", F_crit, "\n")
cat("Using df2 = 100:", F_crit_exact, "\n\n")

# Function to calculate power given n (participants per cell)
calc_power <- function(n) {
  df_denom <- 6 * n - 6
  lambda <- f_sq * df_denom
  F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom)
  power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1 = df_num, df2 = df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  return(power)
}

# Search for minimum n
cat("Power as a function of n (participants per cell):\n")
power_values <- data.frame()

for (n in 1:100) {
  pwr <- calc_power(n)
  power_values <- rbind(power_values, data.frame(n = n, power = pwr))
  
  if (n <= 15 || n %% 10 == 0) {
    cat("n =", sprintf("%3d", n), ": power =", sprintf("%.6f", pwr), "\n")
  }
}

# Find minimum n that achieves target power
min_n <- min(power_values$n[power_values$power >= target_power])
achieved_power <- power_values$power[power_values$n == min_n]
power_at_prev <- power_values$power[power_values$n == min_n - 1]

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat("Minimum participants per cell (n):", min_n, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at n =", min_n, ":", sprintf("%.6f", achieved_power), "\n")
cat("Power at n =", min_n - 1, ":", sprintf("%.6f", power_at_prev), "\n")
cat("\nTotal N (across all 6 cells):", 6 * min_n, "\n")
cat("Denominator df at n =", min_n, ":", 6 * min_n - 6, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter λ at n =", min_n, ":", f_sq * (6 * min_n - 6), "\n")
